title: ANNEX — STANDARDS FOR IMPOSITION OF ADMINISTRATIVE FINES
full_text:
ANNEX — STANDARDS FOR IMPOSITION OF ADMINISTRATIVE FINES
Enforcement Decree of the Korea-Africa Foundation Act (related to Article 10)

1. General standards
(a) The increased fine standards according to the number of violations apply where an administrative fine has been imposed for the same violation within the preceding year. This period is calculated by reference to the date on which the administrative fine was imposed and the date on which the same violation, committed again after that disposition, was detected.
(b) When imposing an increased fine under (a), the applicable violation level is the next level after the disposition level imposed before the violation concerned (the highest level if two or more administrative dispositions were made within the period under (a)).
(c) The imposing authority may reduce the fine under the individual standards in paragraph 2 by up to one-half in any of the following cases. This does not apply to a violator in arrears on administrative fines.
1) The violator falls under any subparagraph of Article 2-2 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Regulation of Violations of Public Order.
2) The violation is recognized as resulting from negligence, such as minor carelessness or error.
3) The violator is recognized as having made efforts to correct or eliminate the unlawful condition.
4) A reduction is otherwise deemed necessary in light of the degree, frequency, motive, and consequences of the violation and other circumstances.

2. Individual standards
Amounts in Korean won (KRW).
| Violation | Legal basis | First violation | Second violation | Third or subsequent violation |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| (a) Use of the name “Korea-Africa Foundation” in violation of Article 22 of the Act | Article 26 (1) of the Act | 500,000 | 1,000,000 | 2,000,000 |
| (b) Use of a name similar to “Korea-Africa Foundation” in violation of Article 22 of the Act | Article 26 (1) of the Act | 250,000 | 500,000 | 1,000,000 |
